question: Provide the full names of drivers who have been overtaken on track more times than they have overtaken others on track during race laps, excluding position changes due to pit stops (both at pit entry and exit), retirements, or position changes that occurred during the first lap of a race (considered as start movements).
sql:
-- Let me check the FULL list - I need to see the ones that are MORE
WITH race_laps AS (
    SELECT 
        race_id, driver_id, lap, position,
        LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) as prev_position
    FROM lap_positions 
    WHERE lap_type = 'Race' AND lap > 1
),
pit_affected AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, lap as affected_lap
    FROM pit_stops
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, lap + 1 as affected_lap
    FROM pit_stops
),
position_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        rl.race_id, rl.driver_id, rl.lap, rl.position, rl.prev_position,
        rl.position - rl.prev_position as pos_change
    FROM race_laps rl
    LEFT JOIN pit_affected pa ON rl.race_id = pa.race_id AND rl.driver_id = pa.driver_id AND rl.lap = pa.affected_lap
    WHERE pa.affected_lap IS NULL
),
overtakes AS (
    SELECT driver_id, COUNT(*) as overtakes_count
    FROM position_changes
    WHERE pos_change < 0
    GROUP BY driver_id
),
being_overtaken AS (
    SELECT driver_id, COUNT(*) as being_overtaken_count
    FROM position_changes
    WHERE pos_change > 0
    GROUP BY driver_id
)
SELECT 
    d.driver_id,
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    COALESCE(o.overtakes_count, 0) as overtakes_count,
    COALESCE(bo.being_overtaken_count, 0) as being_overtaken_count
FROM drivers d
LEFT JOIN overtakes o ON d.driver_id = o.driver_id
LEFT JOIN being_overtaken bo ON d.driver_id = bo.driver_id
WHERE COALESCE(bo.being_overtaken_count, 0) > COALESCE(o.overtakes_count, 0)
